```{r}
#   James
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(multcomp)
###CT_stops <- read_csv("data/CT_stops.csv")
###CT_prediction_set <- read_csv("data/CT_prediction_set.csv")
search_rate_by <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na({{ var }}), !is.na(contraband_found)) %>%
    group_by({{ var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stops     = n(),
      n_contraband  = sum(contraband_found),
      contraband_proportion = mean(contraband_found),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(contraband_proportion))
}

searched <- CT_stops %>% filter(contraband_found)

 
#county_name vs contraband
county_search <- search_rate_by(CT_stops, county_name)
county_search

chisq.test(CT_stops$county_name, CT_stops$contraband_found)

CT_stops$county_name <- factor(CT_stops$county_name)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ county_name, family=binomial, data = CT_stops)
summary(lr)

summary(glht(lr, mcp(county_name="Tukey")))

#driver_gender vs contraband

gender_search <- search_rate_by(CT_stops, driver_gender)
gender_search

CT_stops$driver_gender <- factor(CT_stops$driver_gender)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ driver_gender, family=binomial, data = CT_stops)
summary(lr)

summary(glht(lr, mcp(driver_gender="Tukey")))

#driver_age vs contraband

age_search <- CT_stops %>%
  filter(!is.na(driver_age), !is.na(contraband_found)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(driver_age,
                         breaks = c(15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 100),
                         right = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(n_stops = n(),
            search_rate = mean(contraband_found))

age_search

#driver_race vs contraband

race_search <- search_rate_by(CT_stops, driver_race)
race_search

chisq.test(CT_stops$driver_race, CT_stops$contraband_found)

CT_stops$driver_race <- factor(CT_stops$driver_race)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ driver_race, family=binomial, data = CT_stops)
summary(lr)

summary(glht(lr, mcp(driver_race="Tukey")))

violation_search
```
